name: strata
description: Syntax highlighting and compiler diagnostics for the Strata language.

strata.toolchainPath.description: Path to the strata command. The default assumes it is on PATH, which is what tools/install.sh arranges.

strata.checkOnSave.description: Run strata check when a .sta file is saved and show what it reports.

strata.checkOnType.description: Also check while typing, a moment after you stop.
